comparison.objective: Install and secure a rack rail across front and rear posts; record aligns two flanges and inserts four pins.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require hole registration and multi-point insertion, but the candidate adds long asymmetric support, tab depression, spring-loaded paired engagement, telescoping without losing the first latch, and screw fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires handed orientation, same-rack-unit front/rear retention, full spring extension, self-support, and correct bottom-hole screws; record only states flange placement and four-pin insertion, with rubric tolerances absent from available text.
comparison.reason: This is the closest alignment/insertion record, but its defining test is flange-to-flange pin assembly rather than staged load-bearing rail latching across separated posts. Missing record thresholds do not erase that objective distinction.
